title: 2022 CODATA: Fermi coupling constant is 1.166 3787 × 10^−5
summary: The 2022 CODATA complete listing, from NIST, gives Fermi coupling constant as 1.166 3787 × 10^−5 GeV^-2, with uncertainty 0.000 0006 × 10^−5 GeV^-2.
